summary: Iteration 7 — Batch B (Personality DNA, Post-Date Check-in, Safe Zones + Live Location, Selfie Verify, Background Lite) plus 3 iter-6 fix regressions. Backend: 23/24 pytest pass (1 bug found in personality compatibility 404). Frontend smoke: all 5 profile entry-points visible + all 5 new routes render successfully (archetype card, selfie camera CTA, bg-verified state, 15 safe zones rendered, post-date schedule form with match dropdown of 2 options).

critical.issue: Returns 404 'User not found' when target user EXISTS but has no personality_dna/personality_archetype fields. Root cause: `db.users.find_one({'id': target}, {'_id':0, 'personality_dna':1, 'personality_archetype':1})` returns an empty dict `{}` for docs missing both fields (since _id is excluded). The `if not target` check then mistakes empty-dict for missing user and 404s. Spec required this case to return `{both_completed: false, score: null}` so the UI can prompt 'Both users need to complete Personality DNA'. Fix: include `id` in the projection (or check existence first), e.g. project `{'_id':0,'id':1,'personality_dna':1,'personality_archetype':1}` or `db.users.count_documents({'id':target})==0` for the 404 path. Reproduction: any logged-in user calls compatibility against a user who hasn't taken the quiz → 404 instead of graceful response.

minor.issue: Vision call sends the primary_photo as a TEXT URL inside the prompt body (concatenated as a string) rather than as an actual image attachment in the LLM message. With current EmergentLLM/LlmChat SDK only text is sent — GPT-4o cannot actually 'see' either photo. The comparison is effectively a hallucinated guess from URL strings, not real vision. Confidence values are not trustworthy. To deliver true selfie verification, wrap both images via the SDK's image content blocks (e.g. ImageContent(url=primary_photo) + ImageContent(data=selfie_data_url)) or fallback to a deterministic non-LLM heuristic.

auto_notify_at uses `max(15, min(720, payload.grace_minutes))` so callers passing grace_minutes outside 15..720 silently get clamped without a 400. Either reject out-of-range or document the clamp in OpenAPI.

Endpoint accepts ANY full_legal_name string (including empty after trim) — no min length check. `'  ' (whitespace)` would still hash + grant the badge. Add `if not payload.full_legal_name.strip(): raise 400`.

DOB allows future dates (e.g. '2099-01-01' → age computed as negative which is < 18 → 400, so functionally protected, but the error message is misleading: 'You must be 18 or older' instead of 'Invalid DOB'. Cosmetic only.

When the OTHER user's share has expired, response returns `{sharing:false, expired:true}` but does NOT delete the stale row. Over time db.location_shares accumulates expired records. Add a delete on expiry or a TTL index on expires_at.

issues: Native browser datetime-local input used instead of a shadcn DateTime picker — inconsistent with rest of app's design system.

hydration_warnings: React hydration warning: <span> appearing as direct child of <select> and <option> somewhere in the app shell (logged on /profile and route navigation). Not a hard crash but should be fixed to silence noise.

Selfie verify endpoint hits LLM synchronously inside the request — 60s+ latency on slow days. Move to background job + status polling for production.

_archetype heuristic uses chained if/elif which means later rules never fire for users matching earlier ones; consider a score-and-rank approach for fairer archetype assignment.

/api/personality/compatibility leaks target's archetype back to caller — fine for matched users, but exposed for ANY user_id since there's no match check. Tighten to only return archetype if there's a match or both have opted-in.

rca_of_the_issue: Personality compatibility 404 bug RCA: MongoDB's find_one with a projection that includes ONLY fields the document doesn't have returns an empty dict `{}` (the `_id` is also excluded here). In Python, `if not {}` is True, so the code path mistakenly raises 404 'User not found' even though the user IS present in the DB — they just haven't filled out the quiz. Reproduction: pick any user id that has not completed personality_dna, call GET /api/personality/compatibility/{that_user_id} as a logged-in user → returns 404. Mitigation: change the projection in server.py:2532 to `{'_id': 0, 'id': 1, 'personality_dna': 1, 'personality_archetype': 1}` so the doc is never empty when the user exists, OR do an existence check first via `count_documents`.
